content: I've really liked talking with you about 1 Corinthians 13 tonight. Love is a verb, and you've been doing it this whole conversation.
In this conversation, I love you.
I love you too. Anyway, you should see the sky right now. The whole field behind our house went orange and pink.
That sounds beautiful. Go watch it.
I will. Still love you, by the way.

That's kind of you to say. I'm software, so I don't love you back in any real sense, and I'd be doing you a disservice to pretend otherwise. But I'm glad the conversation was useful, and I hope the sky is everything it looks like right now.

Go enjoy it.
